finalText:
Migration's done. Twelve files were still calling `db.query` across accounts, analytics, billing, catalog, orders, and support — I moved each to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern the rest of the codebase already used.

Left untouched, on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` (vendored code) and every `cache.query` call (a different API, not the database). `node verify.js` confirms it — all call sites moved, nothing else did.
